name: github.com/ten9876/aetherclaude
description: AetherClaude is an autonomous, security-first GitHub agent for the AetherSDR project. It triages incoming issues, reviews pull requests, explains CI failures, detects duplicates, welcomes first-time contributors, and drafts fixes for maintainer-authorized issues. It runs Claude (claude-opus-5) via Claude Code inside a defense-in-depth sandbox: dedicated unprivileged user, pf egress firewall, Cisco Isovalent Tetragon eBPF runtime observability, MCP token-isolation gateway, AI-output scanners, and mandatory human review on every merge. All runs emit traces consumable in the AGNTCY observability schema via the dashboard's /api/agent-walk-otel endpoint.

annotations.observability: Traces exported in the AGNTCY observability schema (OTel GenAI semantic conventions + gen_ai.ioa.* extensions) at /api/agent-walk-otel?trace_id=<id>
annotations.security_architecture: Nine-ring defense-in-depth: unprivileged UID + rbash, pf egress allowlist, Tetragon eBPF TracingPolicies, canary tripwires, tinyproxy egress audit, AI-output scanners (Cisco AI Defense), MCP token-isolation gateway, validation gate, mandatory human merge approval
